## 📋 Usage Example

```python
from demo_meijer_coupons import MeijerWithCoupons

# Initialize and authenticate
meijer = MeijerWithCoupons()
meijer.login_with_credentials(username, password)

# Access coupons as requested
coupons = meijer.coupons  # List[MeijerCoupon]

# Work with individual coupons
for coupon in coupons:
    print(f"Coupon: {coupon.title}")
    print(f"Discount: {coupon.discount_text}")
    print(f"Category: {coupon.primary_category}")
    print(f"Expires: {coupon.days_until_expiry} days")
    
    # Clip/unclip as requested
    if not coupon.is_clipped:
        coupon.clip(True)  # Clip the coupon
        
    # Or use convenience method
    coupon.unclip()  # Unclip the coupon

# Filter methods
clipped = meijer.get_clipped_coupons()
available = meijer.get_available_coupons()
toys_coupons = meijer.get_coupons_by_category("Toys")
expiring = meijer.get_expiring_coupons(days=7)
```
